description: Normalize numbers, currency, phone numbers and units for text-to-speech — Rewrites digits in up to 20000 characters of text into spoken words for a TTS engine, for locales en-US and en-GB: cardinals, ordinals, years (with a preceding cue such as "in" or a month) and decades, decimals, percentages, currency with ISO 4217 minor units ("$12.50" -> "twelve dollars and fifty cents"), phone numbers read digit by digit, and SI/common units with locale spelling (meter/metre). O

locale.description: BCP 47 tag. en-US (default) and en-GB are supported; anything else returns unsupported.

name: speech-normalize
